_note: Event stops on the location map (Claude's drafts, vetted by Logan 2026-09-30: every choice that gains something also costs something, now or in the next fight, and the button says both). Outcomes only use existing mechanics and Refit Bay parts. Event keys (2026-09-30): sectors / missions limit where it comes up, requires_alert (on an event or a choice) needs the Alert (Rescue), steps + an outcome's goto make a multi-step event; a run doesn't repeat an event until it has seen them all. Outcome keys: scraps (negative = a cost, capped at what the pilot has), damage_random_part, repair, gain_part {category, rarity}, next_fight [{side, status, stacks, parts: hardpoints|all|mech}], alert_turns, chance + then/else, goto. Button text is built from the outcome (EventOutcome.summary).

events.title: Derelict Frame
events.text: A downed frame, half buried. Its reactor housing is still warm.

choices.label: Strip the reactor
choices.result: You pry the housing loose. The frame gives way as you pull.

choices.label: Pull its scrap cache
choices.result: Fifty scraps, still sealed. The noise carries.

events.title: Sealed Supply Cache
events.text: A hardened cache, rigged to vent if forced.

choices.label: Cut it open
choices.result: It vents in your face. The scraps are worth it.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.result: Not worth the risk.

events.title: Distress Beacon
events.text: A friendly beacon, looping. Could be a survivor. Could be bait.

then.result: A stranded pilot. They hand over what they carried.

else.result: Bait. They were waiting. Your next fight starts with the enemy braced.

choices.label: Keep moving
choices.result: You mark it and move on.

events.title: Coolant Leak
events.text: A ruptured coolant main, still pressurized.

choices.label: Flush your systems
choices.result: Cold runs through the frame. Repairs hold, but sludge settles in the actuators.

choices.label: Bottle it for later
choices.result: Your hardpoints run cold next fight. The canister bursts as you seal it.

events.title: Abandoned Autonomous Bay
events.text: A bay with its power cut. One locker still answers.

else.result: Empty. The door takes a piece of you on the way out.

choices.label: Sell its scrap
choices.result: Thirty scraps. The salvage takes time.

events.title: Live Relay
events.text: A relay tower, still humming. You could draw from it.

choices.label: Charge your shielding
choices.result: Absorb banked for the next fight. The relay broadcasts your position.

choices.label: Overload it toward them
choices.result: The next enemy group's hardpoints will be Jammed. The feedback bites back.

events.title: Minefield
events.text: The fast route runs through an old minefield.

choices.label: Push through
choices.result: Something goes off under you.

choices.label: Take the long way
choices.result: Slower. They've dug in by the time you arrive.

events.title: Corrupted Signal
events.text: Chatter on an old squad channel. The voice is wrong.

choices.label: Trace it
choices.result: You find where they're staging. Their next group starts Shocked, and so do you: it runs both ways.

choices.label: Cut the channel
choices.result: Silence. Better that way.

events.title: Wrecked Convoy
events.text: A supply convoy, picked over but not clean.

choices.label: Search the trucks
choices.result: A hardpoint, still boxed. Scavengers arrive while you dig.

choices.label: Drain the fuel cells
choices.result: Sixty scraps. Fuel on the frame.

events.title: Field Repair Rig
events.text: A repair rig left running. One charge left.

choices.label: Use it
choices.result: Patched and sealed. The rig takes power to run.

choices.label: Strip it for scraps
choices.result: Forty scraps. It arcs as you cut.

events.title: Flooded Dry Dock
events.text: A dry dock, half flooded. Something big is still clamped in the cradle.

choices.label: Pump it out
choices.result: The pumps grind for an hour. Whatever's out there heard them.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.result: Not worth the noise.

cradle.text: The water drains off a Salvaged frame in the cradle, and a sealed tool locker.

choices.label: Cut the frame free
choices.result: The cradle's clamps snap as it comes loose.

choices.label: Crack the locker
choices.result: Seventy scraps of tools. Their grease gets into everything.

events.title: Gantry Crane
events.text: A gantry crane on autopilot, still swinging containers over the yard.

choices.label: Ride it up for a look
choices.result: From the top you see their patrol lines. The crane drops you hard on the way down.

choices.label: Drop a container on their route

then.result: It lands square on their column. The next group comes in dented.

else.result: It swings back the wrong way.

events.title: Cold Storage Vault
events.text: Server racks in a vault kept near freezing. The cooling plant still answers.

choices.label: Tap the coolant lines
choices.result: Your hardpoints run cold. The vapor clogs your vents.

choices.label: Pull the drives
choices.result: Sixty scraps of storage. The vault's alarm trips as you leave.

events.title: Live Terminal
events.text: A terminal still logged in to their network. The session could time out any second.

choices.label: Open their patrol logs
choices.result: Routes scroll past faster than you can read them.

choices.label: Rip out its power cells
choices.result: Thirty scraps. The terminal arcs as you pull.

logs.text: You have a few seconds. Burn a decryption key to lock their weapons' firmware, or plant a false route and hope they take it.

choices.label: Burn a decryption key
choices.result: Their next group's weapons are stuck in a firmware loop. The key cost you.

then.result: They take it. You catch the next group out of position.

else.result: They trace it back to you. The next group is waiting, and your systems are spiked.

events.title: Runaway Ore Hauler
events.text: An ore hauler rolls downhill with no one at the wheel. There's a sealed parts crate on the back.

choices.label: Board it and grab the crate
choices.result: You get the crate. The hauler takes a piece of you when it hits the pit wall.

choices.label: Steer it into their line
choices.result: It plows into their next group and burns. The debris comes back your way.

events.title: Blasting Charges
events.text: A crate of mining charges, sweating in the heat.

choices.label: Take them
choices.result: You strap the crate down. It runs hot against your frame.

choices.label: Leave them
choices.result: You give the crate a wide berth.

choices.label: Mine their next approach
choices.result: Most go off under them. One goes off early.

choices.label: Sell them to a mining crew
choices.result: Eighty scraps. The crew talks, and the next group is ready.

events.title: Listening Post
events.text: An abandoned listening post on a ridge, its dish still pointed at their backline.

choices.label: Recalibrate the dish
choices.result: You feed it spare parts until it locks on. Their next group's weapons are blind for a turn.

choices.label: Strip the dish
choices.result: A working protocol module. The dish tears loose and clips you.

events.title: Pinned-Down Squad
events.text: Friendly infantry, pinned down, calling for any frame in range.

choices.label: Break them out
choices.result: You clear the position. Their tech patches you up, and they pay what they carry. It takes time.

choices.label: Mark them for extraction
choices.result: They'll cover your flank on the next push while the pickup comes.

choices.label: Keep moving
choices.result: You log their position and go.

events.title: Jammer Array
events.text: A jamming array on a hill, painting your position for their patrols.

choices.label: Wreck it
choices.result: It goes down fighting. Their next group loses its targeting links.

else.result: It screams your position to everyone.

events.title: Unmarked Crate
events.text: A crate with a prototype stencil and a bio-lock that has seen better days.

then.result: Prototype hardware, still in the foam.

else.result: The lock's charge goes off in your hands.

choices.label: Haul it to a broker
choices.result: Sixty scraps. You spend the day hauling it, and grit gets in the actuators.

events.title: Scavenger Frame
events.text: A scavenger frame is stripping a wreck. It hasn't seen you.

choices.label: Chase it off
choices.result: It drops fifty scraps and runs. It comes back with friends, shields up.

choices.label: Trade with it
choices.result: It wants scraps for a reactor it pulled.

events.title: Radio Silence
events.text: Command orders silence while a patrol passes overhead.

choices.label: Hold still and patch up
choices.result: You make field repairs in the dark. The patrol settles in ahead of you.

choices.label: Break silence for a supply drop
choices.result: Sixty scraps in the pod. It lands too close.

choices.label: Ride the patrol's wake
choices.result: You follow them in and hit the next group before it's ready. The patrol notices on the way out.

events.title: Collapsed Depot
events.text: A depot roof has come down on its stock. There's a way in, barely.

choices.label: Squeeze in
choices.result: Tight. Something scrapes your frame the whole way.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.result: You don't trust that roof.

inside.text: Two shelves survived: a boxed part, and sealed repair kits.

choices.label: Take the part
choices.result: A hardpoint, still boxed. The dust gets into your actuators on the way out.

choices.label: Take the kits
choices.result: You patch up, and leave scrap behind to prop the roof.

events.title: Field Tech
events.text: A frightened field tech with a working rig, charging for anything.

choices.label: Pay for repairs
choices.result: Careful work, at a price.

choices.label: Pay for a module
choices.result: The tech pulls a Salvaged protocol from under the bench.

choices.label: Move on
choices.result: The tech watches you go.
